questions.stem:
By using relation
$\Delta G = \Delta H - T\Delta S$
Which of the following relation is incorrect for spontaneous reaction at a given temperature?
questions.solution:
If $\Delta H > 0$, $\Delta S > 0$, then process is spontaneous at high temperature
If $\Delta H > 0$, $\Delta S < 0$, process is always non spontaneous
If $\Delta H < 0$ and $\Delta S > 0$, then process is always spontaneous
If $\Delta H < 0$ and $\Delta S < 0$, then process is spontaneous at low temperature.

questions.stem: When a non-volatile solute (A) is added to a volatile solvent, the vapour pressure of solvent decreases by 10 mm Hg. Mole fraction of solute in solution is 0.2. If another non-volatile solute (B) is further added to the same solution and vapour pressure of solution decreases by 20 mm Hg, calculate mole fraction of $2^{nd}$ solute in the final solution.
questions.solution:
For solute (A),
$X_A = 0.2$
$\Delta P = 10$ mm Hg
Let $P^{o}_{solvent}$ be vapour pressure of pure solvent
$\frac{\Delta P}{P^{o}_{solvent}} = X_A$
$P^{o}_{solvent} = \frac{10}{0.2} = 50$ mm Hg
For solute (B),
Let number of moles of solvent be 0.8 and $n_B$ be the number of moles of (B) added, then
$X_B = \frac{n_B}{0.2 + 0.8 + n_B} = \frac{n_B}{1 + n_B}$
$\Delta P' = 10 + 20 = 30$ mm Hg
$\frac{\Delta P'}{P^{o}_{solvent}} = \frac{0.2 + n_B}{1 + n_B}$
$\frac{30}{50} = \frac{0.2 + n_B}{1 + n_B}$
$\Rightarrow n_B = 1$
$X_B = \frac{1}{1 + 1} = 0.5$

questions.stem:
Consider the following $E^\circ$ values of given half cell
$E^\circ_{\mathrm{Ag^+/Ag}} = 0.8\ \mathrm{V}, E^\circ_{\mathrm{Zn^{2+}/Zn}} = -0.76\ \mathrm{V}$
$E^\circ_{\mathrm{Cu^{2+}/Cu}} = 0.34\ \mathrm{V}, E^\circ_{\mathrm{Mg^{2+}/Mg}} = -2.36\ \mathrm{V}$
Then which of the following will have the most negative value of $\Delta G^\circ$?
questions.solution:
The cell which has most positive value of $E^\circ_{Cell}$ will have most negative value of $\Delta G^\circ$.
$E^{o}_{cell} = E^{o}_{\mathrm{Ag^+|Ag}} - E^{o}_{\mathrm{Mg^{2+}|Mg}} = 0.8 - (-2.36) = 3.16\mathrm{V}$
$\Delta G^\circ = -nFE^\circ_{Cell}$
